fx.kind: PBOC/CFETS central parity published by SAFE
fx.semantics: 100 USD = 671.88 CNY (direct quotation). Used only to translate published CNY amounts into USD. A central parity is NOT a customer's executable retail rate.
fx.spread_note: The retail bid/ask spread a customer actually pays is not published by any bank reviewed here. It is therefore null everywhere in this dataset and flagged F-SPREAD. All totals below are a FLOOR, not a full cost.

meta.floor_warning: Every total excludes the retail FX spread, which no reviewed bank publishes. Treat all figures as a FLOOR.
notes: Bank tariff parameters from HSBC China's published account-service rates effective 2021-01-01 (C01). Other banks publish different tariffs; this is one bank's published schedule, not an industry rate.
CNY amounts are converted at the SAFE-published central parity for 2026-11-09, 1 USD = 6.7188 CNY (P14). A central parity is not an executable retail rate.

Chinese tax on the ACT of conversion is zero for every lawful route, because a currency conversion is not one of the nine IIT income categories (P11 Art.2). The real Chinese tax attaches to the income behind the money and is a user-specific fact this table cannot compute.
US tax on the transfer is zero. 26 USC 988 makes FX gain ordinary income but excludes personal transactions unless the gain exceeds US$200 (U05).
